selection: step-out from bonsai1/L29/N7370+ (10x queue, model pilot: haiku)

neighbours.label: the opening quote before a language or locale code in a setting (locale = 'pt')
fire: Set the interface to lang = 'fi' in the config file before you deploy.
The browser sent Accept-Language: 'ko' with every request from the kiosk.
In settings.ini, the entry translation = 'cy' selects the Welsh strings.
Our test harness loops over the list ['de', 'it', 'ro'] when it checks the strings.
If the user picks locale='nb', the page should render in Norwegian Bokmal.
Set hreflang='el' on the alternate link for the Greek version of the page.
The importer reads the column code 'tr' and maps each row to Turkish text.
Pass the flag preferred_lang='vi' and the server returns the Vietnamese copy.
quiet: Set the interface to theme = 'dark' in the config file before you deploy.
The browser sent Accept-Encoding: 'gzip' with every request from the kiosk.
In settings.ini, the entry timeout = '30' sets how long the client waits.
Our test harness loops over the list ['red', 'blue', 'green'] when it checks the strings.
If the user picks size='xl', the page should render in the larger layout.
Set rel='nofollow' on the alternate link for the Greek version of the page.
The importer reads the column code 'A7' and maps each row to a shelf number.
Pass the flag verbose='yes' and the server returns the full request log.

notes: Model pilot (haiku arm; the same pole is tested independently by the other arm, pairing disclosed): this pole feeds the held pole bonsai1/L29/N7370+ (zeroing this neuron removes 1.00 of the anchor's peak), from a batched edge measurement with 8 same-layer placebos. Label and all 16 sentences written by the Haiku 5.5 labeller from a packet (card + all-pole band samples + the edge hint) and one probe round of 8 sentences (none reused). An Opus gate checked rule-level items only and edited nothing. Labeller's note: Probes: the quote before 'pt' in a locale setting scored 0.81, but the dropdown and name-field probes only reached 0.17 to 0.19, so the pole fires mainly on a quoted code inside a setting. Near misses use the same settings frames with quoted non-language values, which stayed low in the probes. A quoted language code in other contexts may stay below threshold, so expect a partial result.
